label: EXTERNAL INPUT (dataset licence, checked at its official source)
official_source_finding: The CUAD page shows the badge "CC BY 4.0"; describes "Contract Understanding Atticus Dataset (CUAD) v1", 510 commercial legal contracts, 41 clause types, more than 13,000 labels; links GitHub (https://github.com/TheAtticusProject/cuad) and Hugging Face (https://huggingface.co/datasets/theatticusproject/cuad).
second_source_finding: Dataset card metadata license: cc-by-4.0 (Hugging Face Hub, read 2026-10-29).
github_repo_finding: https://github.com/TheAtticusProject/cuad lists no LICENSE file and no licence statement in its readme (checked 2026-10-29); the licence is taken from the official Atticus page and the Hugging Face card.
obligations: CC BY 4.0: attribution required (credit The Atticus Project and the CUAD paper, link the licence, state changes). Redistribution allowed, but this repo commits only a manifest (results/cuad_manifest_v1.json), no contract or clause text.
